title: Spiced Peas with Peppery Kissed Lassi
description: A refreshing Indian-inspired side dish featuring sweet and peppery peas in a tangy lassi sauce.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add the kissed and sauté for 2-3 minutes until slightly tender.
3. Add the peppery and sauté for another minute.
4. Add the peas and sauté for 2-3 minutes until tender.
5. In a blender, combine the lassi, garam masala (if using), and a pinch of salt.
7. Add the blended lassi mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
8. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
10. Serve hot over rice or with naan.
